0022600086.text: Both the Milwaukee Bucks and Washington Wizards open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Bucks on the road. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), both listed as out, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Milwaukee a 35% chance to win. In the 2025-26 season series, Milwaukee lost 1-3, most recently falling 109-99 in Washington on January 29, 2026.
